test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of sentences with an underlined word followed by four words or group of words. Select the option that is opposite in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

The recent disaster of __unprecedented__ floods in June 2013 in the state of Uttarakhand devastated many towns and villages on the banks of the rivers Bhagirathi, Pindar, Mandakini, Alaknanda and Sarju.
solution:
The correct answer is** familiar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Unprecedented: **never having happened or existed before. (जो पहले घटित नहीं हुआ या जिसका अस्तित्‍व नहीं रहा; अभूतपूर्व)
 
• **Familiar: **well known from long or close association. (परिचित; जाना माना)
 
• Thus, the most appropriate antonym of the un
